shared_elements: relief figures arranged along a flat vertical face
justification: Both surfaces show animals in profile carved in low relief on a flat face organised in horizontal bands, but that is about as generic as animal relief gets. A shows a narrative procession of human attendants leading horned rams beside a stylised tree, framed by rosette borders, while B shows isolated, schematic animal and serpentine forms with no human figures, no framing ornament and no processional relationship.
